name: conventions
title: Interpretation conventions behind the expected values
description: Every choice the expected values depend on that CTCAE wording does not settle, with the default reading and, where one is published, the alternative profile that holds the other reading. Profiles: DEFAULT, BESTCASE_ENZYMES, HYPERGLY_NUMERIC_V5, PRESENT_NOT_LAB, UNGRADABLE_ZERO, BASELINE_STRICT.

fields.name: CONVENTION
fields.description: Code referenced by criteria.csv CONVENTION and records.csv CONVENTIONS

fields.name: SCOPE
fields.description: GRADING = how a CTCAE criterion is read; DATA = how record states are handled (baseline, missing data, units, specimen)

fields.name: CTCAE_WORDING
fields.description: Quoted CTCAE text that leaves the choice open (blank for DATA conventions)

fields.name: DEFAULT_CHOICE
fields.description: Reading used by the DEFAULT profile

fields.name: ALTERNATIVE_PROFILE
fields.description: Profile in expectations.csv that publishes the alternative, when one exists

fields.name: LBTESTCD
fields.description: Space-separated test codes concerned, or ALL

fields.name: CONVENTION_DEP
fields.description: Y = a record whose expectation depends on this convention is flagged CONVENTION_DEP = Y in records.csv
